comments.author: Igor
comments.body: Taheebo juice can be purchased in Grand Cayman, Willemstad, Trujillo, Maracaibo, Caracas or Cayenne.

comments.author: Francine
comments.body: Taheebo juice can also be purchased at the item shop in Portobelo.
